eps.t: Archive Thrifting #34: Getting Back On The Horse
eps.o: Consider this a “soft-launch” of Season 14 of OA. I’m finally off the sidelines and…things are as dusty as ever.
KLAK has had to take on a few advertisers*. Tough times, ya know… *Yes, YouTube, this is a joke. This is NOT a sponsored video.
The OA equivalent of popcorn, pretzel sticks and jellybeans as a Thanksgiving feast…
The Archive serves up some true Christmas Hams…with a side of Duck A La Wronge.
The Archive takes the high road…to a dead-end.
…because three hours a night of late 80’s primetime TV lameness just wasn’t enough!
Well, it’s Oscar season. Let’s pretend current Hollywood doesn’t exist.

eps.t: Local TV Vol. 10 (A Fifth of Commercials)
eps.o: Another round of classic local TV bliss delivered in easy-to-digest 30-second bites…
Yes, teenaged Benny-boy managed to blindly stumble into the “digital music revolution” circa Y2K. No, he did NOT turn into a cyberpunk warrior—he just became a prematurely grouchy old man.
It’s the 300th “regular” OA episode. Let’s make some noise…albeit not necessarily PLEASANT noise.
Time to get lucky! In the financial sense, that is…
